records.key: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is a legitimate thing to want and gives a different table.
records.source: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is a legitimate thing to want and gives a different table.
records.translation: Hluturinn sem allt annað er tekið saman á. Hann ákveður hvað röð í sameinuðu töflunni merkir — að taka frumur saman á sýkla er fullgilt markmið og gefur aðra töflu.
